solves: Gives the person a field where typing filters a long list of options to pick one, and takes part in the form that contains it.
use_when: When the list is long and the person knows the name of what they look for: typing filters it.
Inside an nph-field, which gives the label, the help text and the error message.
With the status dot when each option has a state, written in the option text.
With creatable only when the list accepts new items; with the shortcuts footer on screens used a lot by keyboard.
default in most forms; large when the form uses tall fields.
do_not_use_when: For a short list that fits on the screen without search: use nph-select.
To pick several options: use nph-multi-combobox.
To offer create in a closed list: leave creatable off, and the list shows the nph-empty.
To change the color of the arrow area: for an error, use invalid through nph-field.
To use the status dot without a written state.

options.constraint: Property only. The entries of the list, in order: an option (type absent or option) with value and text, and optionally secondary, start, icon, src, status and disabled, which the combobox draws as an nph-option; a label (type label, with text) that names the group after it; and a separator (type separator) that closes a group. An invalid entry is left out, with one console.error per cause in development.

size.constraint: The height of the field and the width of the arrow area: control/height-default or control/height-large. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

value.constraint: The current value: the value of the chosen option. The value attribute is the initial value and the value of form.reset(), as in nph-input (P80). The chosen option is the first option with that value; the value is kept until such an option arrives. Setting it from code fires no event.

query.constraint: Property only. The typed text; empty while the field shows the chosen option. Setting it from code writes it in the field and filters the list, and fires no event. It is not the value: leaving the field without choosing clears it.

placeholder.constraint: The invitation before a choice, already localized, such as "Search a country". It is not a name.

start.constraint: The start of the field (the Figma `início`). search: the magnifying glass, decorative. icon: the icon of the chosen option when its own start is icon, otherwise the icon property. avatar: the photo of the chosen option when its own start is avatar, otherwise the empty avatar. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

icon.constraint: A core name of nph-icon: the start icon with start=icon. Any name outside the core draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

clearable.constraint: The clear button (the Figma `limpar`): it shows with a chosen option or typed text, and erases both. It needs clear-label; without it, the button is not drawn and console.error is emitted in development.

clear-label.constraint: The accessible name of the clear button, already localized. Required with clearable.

filter.constraint: contains: the list keeps the options whose text contains the typed text, with no difference of case or accent. none: the consumer filters options itself, as a search that answers from a server, with nph-search and loading. The highlight shows in both. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

loading.constraint: The `carregando` list: the nph-spinner instead of the options, while the search answers. It needs loading-label; without it, the spinner has no name and console.error is emitted in development.

loading-label.constraint: The accessible name of the spinner, already localized, such as "Searching".

creatable.constraint: The `criar` list: after the results, a row offers the typed text as a new item, unless an option already says it. Only for a list that accepts new items. It needs create-label; without it, the row is not drawn and console.error is emitted in development.

create-label.constraint: The words of the create row before the typed text, already localized, such as "Create".

empty-heading.constraint: The title of the nph-empty when nothing matches (the `vazio` list). Empty: with nothing to show, the list does not open.

empty-description.constraint: The description of the nph-empty when nothing matches.

open.constraint: The list is open. The piece opens and closes it; the consumer may set it. Opening and closing fire no event. A disabled combobox, or one with nothing to show, does not open.

name.constraint: The name of the entry in the form data. Reflects because the form reads the attribute of the host. With no chosen option, the entry is left out.

required.constraint: With no choice, or with a chosen option of empty value, the piece is valueMissing, with the message of the browser. nph-field writes it.

disabled.constraint: The whole piece at state/disabled-opacity, on color/muted, out of the Tab order and of the form data; the list does not open and the clear button hides. A disabled fieldset disables it too. It wins over invalid.

invalid.constraint: The error state: the border becomes status/error and the field gets aria-invalid. It is not a constraint of the form. The sentence belongs to nph-field.

label.constraint: The accessible name in text, never visible, for a combobox with no associated label; nph-field writes it. An associated label wins over it.

description.constraint: The accessible description in text, never visible: the help or the error sentence that nph-field writes.

shortcuts.constraint: The `atalhos` footer of the list: the nph-kbd keys and their words, as the consumer writes them. An element in the slot turns the footer on (D-2).

input.constraint: Fired by the host when the person changes the value: a choice of a different option, the clear button or the create row. It bubbles and crosses shadow roots. Typing does not fire it: the native input of the inner field stays in the shadow root.

change.constraint: Fired by the host right after input. It bubbles. Setting value, query or open from code fires neither event.

nph-search.constraint: detail.query: the typed text changed by the person, also when leaving the field clears it. It bubbles and crosses shadow roots. The consumer that filters searches with it.

nph-create.constraint: detail.text: the person chose the create row. It fires before input and change; the value becomes the text, and the consumer adds the option to options.

size.choose_when: default in most forms; large when the form uses tall fields. One size per form.
do_not_combine_with: default and large fields in the same form.

start.choose_when: search in general; icon when a symbol helps recognize the option; avatar when the options are people.
do_not_combine_with: Options with and without a start in the same list.

default.changes_for_user: The resting border, on color/background, with the divider and the arrow area in color/accent.

hover.changes_for_user: The border goes one step darker under the pointer.

focus.changes_for_user: Focus on the text: the border takes focus/border with the focus/halo attached outside.

open.changes_for_user: The focus look with the list open below the field and the arrow up (chevron-up).

focus-clear.changes_for_user: Keyboard focus on the clear button: the ring follows only the button; the field keeps its resting border.

error.changes_for_user: The border is status/error, also on hover; the sentence is in nph-field.

error-focus.changes_for_user: The border stays status/error and the halo is focus/halo-error.

disabled.changes_for_user: The whole piece at state/disabled-opacity on color/muted, with the color/input border; it does not open and wins over the error.

business_rules: Typing opens the list, filters it and makes the first match active; Enter chooses it (D-5).
The person chooses by a click on an option, or by Enter or Alt+ArrowUp on the active option; the list closes, the field shows the option text and the focus stays on it.
A change of the value by the person fires input and then change; choosing the option already chosen, Escape, Tab, a click outside and code fire nothing.
Leaving the field without choosing gives it the text of the chosen option again; the typed text is never the value, except through the create row.
Tab closes the list without choosing, and the focus moves on.
Enter with the list closed submits the form; with the list open, it chooses.
Escape closes the open list; with the list closed, it clears the typed text (D-4).
Disabled options are skipped by the keyboard and cannot be chosen.
The create row shows only with creatable, with typed text that no option already says.
domain_errors: invalid: the choice needs correction, such as a required field with no choice; nph-field writes the sentence and passes it as description.

tokens.border: border/width, in color/input, color/input-hover, focus/border or status/error
tokens.padding: space/control-padding on the left; 0 on the right
tokens.text: text/body-md in color/foreground; the placeholder in color/muted-foreground
tokens.start: nph-icon icon/size-sm in color/muted-foreground, or nph-avatar sm
tokens.clear: nph-icon xmark icon/size-sm with space/inline-tight around it
tokens.arrow_area: color/accent, control/height-* wide, radius/none on the left and radius/control-inner on the right; the arrow icon/size-sm in color/muted-foreground
tokens.list: color/popover, border/width in color/input, radius/container, elevation/dropdown, padding space/inline-tight, maximum height layout/max-list-height
tokens.highlight: text/highlight-weight on the typed stretch; color/muted-foreground on the rest
tokens.group_label: text/label-sm in color/muted-foreground, space/inline on the sides and space/inline-tight above and below
tokens.separator: nph-separator with space/inline-tight above and below
tokens.footer: border/width in color/border above, space/inline around, text/label-sm in color/muted-foreground
tokens.motion: motion/enter-duration, motion/enter-easing, motion/exit-duration and motion/exit-easing; motion/hover-duration with reduced motion
tokens.focus: focus/border, focus/halo, focus/halo-error, focus/ring-width, focus/radius-control and, on the clear button, focus/border-radius-control and focus/radius-control-with-border

ai_hints: Use nph-combobox for one choice in a long list the person searches by name; for a short list, nph-select; for several, nph-multi-combobox.
Put nph-combobox inside nph-field, which gives the label, the help text and the error message.
Give the options as data in options, never as children; one start for the whole list.
For a search that answers from a server, set filter=none, listen to nph-search, set loading and then the new options.
Turn creatable on only when the list accepts new items, and add the option on nph-create.
Read the value from the host on input or change; read the typed text from nph-search or query.
Never use the placeholder as the only name.

accessibility.semantics: An editable combobox with list autocomplete (APG): the inner text field has role combobox, aria-autocomplete list, aria-expanded and aria-controls; the list has role listbox, the groups role group named by their label, and each nph-option role option with aria-selected. The host is form-associated and labelable.
accessibility.accessible_name: From the label associated with the host, which the field and the list reference. Without one, from label. The placeholder is not a name. The clear button is named by clear-label. With no name at all, the combobox renders and warns in development.
keyboard: Characters write in the field, open the list, filter it and make the first match active.
Closed: ArrowDown and ArrowUp open on the chosen option, or on the first or the last; Alt+ArrowDown opens without moving; Enter submits the form; Escape clears the typed text.

Open: ArrowDown and ArrowUp move without wrapping; PageDown and PageUp move ten options; Enter and Alt+ArrowUp choose the active option and close; Escape closes without choosing; Tab closes without choosing and the focus moves on.
Home and End move the cursor in the text.
accessibility.focus: The focus stays on the text; the active option is pointed to by aria-activedescendant, in the same shadow root. The field shows the focus border and the halo while it has the focus and while the list is open; the clear button has its own ring.
accessibility.contrast: The text of the field and of the option meets 4.5:1 and the border 3:1, in light and dark mode; the arrow keeps 3:1 on color/accent; the rest of the text outside the highlight, in color/muted-foreground, passes 4.5:1. The disabled state is exempt.
accessibility.color_alternative: The error is said by the sentence of nph-field; the dot goes with the written state; the highlight changes the weight of the text; the arrow turns up when the list opens.

invalid_combinations: A size outside default and large — the combobox draws nothing.
A start outside search, icon and avatar — the combobox draws nothing.
An icon outside the core names — the combobox draws nothing.
A filter outside contains and none — the combobox draws nothing.
clearable without clear-label — no clear button.
creatable without create-label — no create row.
invalid without the sentence in nph-field — red with no text.
anti_patterns: Using it for a short list that fits on the screen without search.
Offering create in a closed list.
Changing the color of the arrow area: for an error, use invalid.
Using the status dot without a written state.
Writing the options as nph-option children of the combobox.
